summary: Retroactive confirmation of docs/specs/repo-system-of-record.md, whose capture and display work shipped before the spec was confirmed. The spec's own decision table was user-locked when written, so re-asking those would only restate the document. The grill instead hunted drift between the spec and the shipped system, and the scope of what a retroactive confirmation attests.
gaps: Confirming a spec after its work shipped attests that it describes the system as built, but three of its verification items cannot be checked from a terminal: the light/dark/760px screenshot pass, the read-only filesystem-digest invariant, and the manual half of the parallel-merge check. Confirming without saying so would imply an attestation nobody made.
resolutions: Verified the substantive capture behaviour against the running system rather than taking it on faith: `forge outcome set` writing .factory/outcome.json and pr_ready checking it; the append-only .factory/events.jsonl; decision<->story links in frontmatter (0018 carries stories: [FORGE-DELEG-1]); `roadmap add --no-spec --reason` capturing spec debt; and the board's per-task disclosures. The spec matches what the system does.

Put the scope question to the maintainer, who chose to confirm as-is with the capture layer as what is attested, and to record the three unverifiable items as open items rather than silently folding them in.
open_items: Not verified at confirmation: the light/dark/760px screenshot pass. Visual QA from the original round; no automated check exists.
Not verified at confirmation: the read-only invariant's before/after filesystem digest. The board server is GET-only by construction and the spec's automated tests cover the POST refusal.
Not verified at confirmation: the manual half of the parallel-merge check. The automated union-merge test for .factory/events.jsonl is in the suite and green.
Decision 0017-repo-as-system-of-record remains `proposed` while the capability it governs is live. Acceptance is human chat confirmation and is not part of this spec gate.
